have hyl : LR.divided y l (LR.vec y v 0) = LR.vec y v l := by

have hq (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ l) :

  rw [Module.End.mul_apply, hx l k hk]
  by_cases he : k = l
  · subst k

  · have hn : ¬ l ≤ k := by omega

  by_cases he : k = top
  · subst k
    simp [top, hb]
  · have hn : k.val ≠ l := by
      intro hh
      apply he
      apply Fin.ext
      exact hh

  by_cases he : k = top

· intro j
  rw [← hqeq]
  apply b.ext
  intro k
  rw [Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, hu, hb k, hy (l-j.val) k.val (Nat.le_of_lt_succ k.isLt)]

        apply he
